Improved resolution of DDS fields in a LF that references a PF that references a Dictionary PF <br>• Screen - Cleared indicators when CLEAR statement is used to clear a record from DSPF <br>• CL - Improved transformation/generation of CL params with element lists ### Transversal capabilities **Improvements** <br>• SQL - Improved generation of SQL queries containing N with tilde character <br>• COBOL - Improved support of the statement LENGTH OF for group fields <br>• COBOL - Improved support of REDEFINED fields using copybooks ## Release notes 4.2.0 Release date: July 10, 2024 This release of AWS Blu Age Runtime and Modernization Tools is focused on performance and security. Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• We improved transformation performance, especially for large projects with over 30 million lines of code. We implemented a set of improvements and the results we obtained showed a time reduction of over 150%, and runs that completed in minutes instead of hours. The key improvement we implemented is the configuration of a timeout mechanism to limit the maximum time allocated for analysis so as to skip files with detected issues. We mark skipped files so that you can investigate them later if necessary. <br>• We added support for a distributed lock management system for AS400 projects. In a High Availability environment (multi-node) where multiple instances of the application target the same database, maintaining data consistency throughout the life cycle of these instances is a significant challenge. To effectively address this challenge, we added Redis as a shared and external caching server to coordinate among all instances when running in batch mode. <br>• We added a new dynamic pagination feature for the table component. The goal of this feature is to improve the response time and reduce memory usage for tables with a large number of rows. This feature allows the table component to only load part of the data, and to fetch more records on demand as you navigate through the pages. To further improve the experience, the platform also supports the prefetching of data. This new dynamic pagination feature provides a more efficient and responsive user experience for applications with large data sets. <br>• To address a key challenge that comes up frequently, we added support for nested COBOL programs. Previously, the workaround for modernizing nested COBOL programs involved manually separating programs into different files, linking them through the linkage section, and making them call each other with the necessary arguments. This process was not only time-consuming but also error-prone. You can now modernize nested COBOL programs without the need for manual separation. We tested this version of the AWS Blu Age Runtime with the following stack. Other component versions might also be compatible.                                                      |
| Persistence layer         | PostgreSQL engine 14      |
| Oracle 21c                |
| Application server        | Apache Tomcat 10.1.17     | For more information about the changes included in this release, see the following sections. ## Runtime release 4.2.0 ### zOS **New features** <br>• DB2 - Added support for stored procedure invocation without schema qualifier in the SQL query <br>• COBOL - Added support for HEX-OF function <br>• COBOL - Added support for nested programs <br>• COBOL - Added support for FUNCTION TEST-DATE-YYYYMMDD and TEST-DAY-YYYYDDD <br>• CICS - Added support for option UCTRANST in the SET TERMINAL command <br>• CICS - Added support for the INQUIRE DB2CONN command <br>• <noloc>Blusam</noloc> - Added support for key deletion on dynamically accessed VSAM <br>• IMS - Added support for the TERM command <br>• BAC - Added authorization checks on all BAC REST endpoints <br>• BAC - Added configuration through `application-main.yaml` to define a record size to filter loaded masks that match that record size <br>• BAC and JAC : Added configuration through `application-main.yaml` to retrieve the username and the password of the default super admin user in the secret from `command` by specifying the ARN **Improvements** <br>• JCL - SORT - Enhanced support for OMIT clause to handle conditions with Shiftin and ShiftOut characters <br>• JCL - SORT - Improved support for the BDW field <br>• JCL - SORT - Improved support for multiple GDG concatenations with the BDW field <br>• JCL - DFSORT - Added support for INREC PARSE STARTAFT / STARTAT clauses <br>• JCL - IEBGENER - Enhanced recordSize handling for output files <br>• JCL - INFUTILB - Disabled NULL INDICATOR based on YML- FIX GRAPHIC CASE <br>• JCL - Improved support for FormatterParser to handle constants in the OUTREC field <br>• JCL - Enhanced load data for graphic type in DSNUTILB program utility <br>• JCL - SORT - Enhanced support for Zoned Decimal format <br>• JCL - SORT - Enhanced support for the OMIT clause to handle conditions with Shiftin and ShiftOut characters <br>• MQ - Improved the handling of MQ connection to fit several business workflows <br>• CICS - Enhanced support of pointer reference for EXEC CICS READ SET (ptr-ref) statements <br>• COBOL - Improved support for ADDRESS OF linkage section record <br>• COBOL - Added support for EXP and EXP10 functions <br>• COBOL - Improved support for the REPLACE statement using copybook <br>• COBOL - Improved multidimensional field access to support signed values <br>• MF COBOL - Added support for variable-format sequential files <br>• IMS - Improved reading of the configuration of IMS YML files to make it possible to use environment variables <br>• IMS - Handled additional ways of specifying the segment number <br>• IMS - Added robustness when an IMS program is called from a programatically-started transaction <br>• IMS - Improved the search criteria SSA build to take the current length of the WHERE clause into account if the implied segment length is not provided <br>• IMS - Improved reading of the configuration of IMS YML files to allow the use of environment variables <br>• Improved support for the VALUE clause in NumericEditedType <br>• Improved support for string concatenation to handle the case when the first string to be concatenated is empty, blank, or spaces ### AS400 **New features** <br>• Added support for pagination inside the Table component; projects can use this feature to decrease the response time and size when a Table component with a large number of rows is loaded <br>• Added library support for SQL queries on the AS400 application; because libraries are converted to partitions in modern applications, we adapted the runtime to rewrite the queries accordingly <br>• RPG - Added support for the QTEMP library for SQL queries <br>• RPG - Added encoding in the CONVERT function to handle empty input values <br>• RPG - Added support for the %HOURS, %MINUTES, and %SECONDS functions <br>• CL - Added the CHGPFM command <br>• CL - Added support for the \*FROMLIB keyword in the CRTDUPOBJ command <br>• CL - Added support for table and partition creation for table names exceeding 9 characters <br>• CL - Added support for deletion of flat files in subfolders for the DLTF command **Improvements** <br>• Screen - Improved ErrorMessage to bind with specific field and add to ArrayMessageLine <br>• Screen - Improved errormsg cursor <br>• Screen - Improved ArrayMessageLine to not be included in Tab Order <br>• Screen - Improved display of error message arrays for AS400 screen <br>• SQL - Improved cursor support to commit Transaction upon closing to avoid deadlocks on partition creation <br>• CL - Added support for the PgmCall command and improved the QCMDEXC unsupported pattern <br>• CL - Improved support for the CHKOBJ command to handle OBJTYPE PGM <br>• CL - Improved multi-library support for CPYF and other CL commands that deal with libraries and partitions <br>• CL - Added support for passing a program name variable in the CALL PGM command <br>• CL - Handled the case for default type of Object type <br>• CL - Added multi-library support for the CRTDUPOBJ command <br>• CL - Enhanced database connection handling on multiple commands <br>• CL - Improved support for RMVLNK to handle the case when a file or directory isn't found and the CPF0000 monitor message <br>• CL - Improved CLRPFM to take the library into account when removing records <br>• CL - CPYF - Improved command to support the QTEMP library, FmtOpt(\*NoChk) parameter, and control character <br>• CL - Fixed handling of quotation marks and missing parameters in the RMVLNK and CPY commands <br>• RPG - Enhanced variable scoping; DataArea is now in working scope instead of linkage scope <br>• RPG - Improved DAO read queries to run without a transaction to avoid deadlocks <br>• Enhanced MQ messaging lookup by adding a trim to MSGQ on DB lookup <br>• Removed unnecessary transaction declarations on database connection support <br>• Improved the update of Quartz job status in case of exception <br>• Added support to handle the case when an indicator array isn't initialized ### Transversal capabilities **New features** <br>• Redis - Added global Redis configuration for all Redis caches <br>• Added session-tracking functionality to make it possible to store session-tracking information (session ID, associated username, creation timestamp, and node ID) by persisting the data to Redis <br>• Added temporary location configuration for runtime resolved groovy files through the YML property `tempFilesDirectory`; also added the capability to specify whether to purge contents of the temporary files folder at application startup through the YML property `cleanTempFilesDirectoryAtStartup` **Improvements** <br>• Enhanced support for connection pool implementation configuration properties for utility data sources <br>• Improved support for printer mode and ANSI carriage control based on the usage of ADVANCING clauses and WRITE BEFORE clauses <br>• Updated Angular version on front-end application for modernized projects <br>• Enhanced secret manager URL syntax construction for DB2 <br>• Enhanced the DataUtils.compareAlphInt method to add support for trailing spaces <br>• Improved SQL support for blob type output <br>• Added robustness for job triggers through post/script endpoint ## Modernization tools release 4.2.0 ### zOS **New features** <br>• CICS - Added support for parsing WEB CICS commands <br>• CICS - Added support for the transformation of the MONITOR command <br>• CICS - Added support for parsing the CICS command SEND MRO <br>• COBOL - Added support for parsing the NO REWIND statement <br>• COBOL - Added support for number type of option UCTRANST in the CICS command SET TERMINAL <br>• COBOL - Add supported for the MULTIPLE FILE clause in I-O-SECTION <br>• CSD - Added support for the transformation of multiple CSD files <br>• CSD - Added support for the generation of jicsFileAix.json from multiple CSD files <br>• IDCAMS - Added support for the creation of a relative record data set (RRDS) **Improvements** <br>• Improved performance when computing SQL masks <br>• COBOL - Improved parsing of useless RESERVE clause in FILE-CONTROL <br>• COBOL - Improved parsing of SECTION and CLASS <br>• COBOL - Improved DFHRESP handling <br>• COBOL - Enhanced support for EXIT PARAGRAPH through perform <br>• IMS - Improved support for segment names specified by using double parentheses <br>• IMS - Enriched the generation of status codes when SCHD and TERM are invoked <br>• COBOL - Improved generation of DEPENDING ON fields <br>• COBOL - Improved transformation of TO_TIMESTAMP DB2 builtin function ### AS400 **New features** <br>• Added support for converting alphanumeric fields as CHAR in SQL scripts <br>• COBOL400 - Added support for program-described DATABASE files **Improvements** <br>• DDS - Improved support for ALIAS name <br>• Enhanced support for type float without initial value <br>• COBOL 400 - Improved size compute for signed zoned type ### Transversal capabilities **Improvements** <br>• Improved error ID reporting around DDS and SQL parsing <br>• Improved code generation on condition branches <br>• Improved performance on weather report generation ## Release notes 4.1.0 Release date: May 31, 2024 This release of AWS Blu Age Runtime and Modernization Tools is focused on performance and security. Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• **Transformation and performance**: To allow projects with a large codebase (+50M lines of code) to transform successfully, we have optimized the performance and memory footprint of the whole transformation mechanism. <br>• **BAC/JAC**: Security at AWS is the highest priority. Applications modernized with AWS Blu Age must comply with security standards. We have made some major upgrades to the <noloc>Blusam</noloc> Administration Console (BAC) and the JICS Administration Console (JAC) to make them more secure: + Updated the application to Angular v17. + In addition to the native support for AWS Cognito, we added generic support for OAuth that will enable more flexibility to let customers use the identity provider of their choice. + Configured and extended the security features using appropriate headers. <br>• _AS400 - Multi-node support for database lock mechanism._ Provided the possibility to plug a shared and external caching server (Redis) to run a batch application on multiple instances, like managed AWS Mainframe Modernization. This version of the Blu Age runtime has been tested with the following stack. Other versions might also be compatible.                                                      |
| Persistence layer         | PostgreSQL engine 14      |
| Oracle 21c                |
| Application server        | Apache Tomcat 10.1.17     | For more information about the changes included in this release, see the following sections. ## Runtime release 4.1.0 ### zOS **New features** <br>• Added configuration for dynamic OAuth2 provider handling. Introduced SECRET_OAUTH2_PROVIDER_NAME_KEY to specify provider. Updated secret retrieval method to handle multiple providers. Ensured secrets are securely retrieved from AWS Secrets Manager. <br>• Added support for DB2 SSL properties on AWS Secrets Manager to make it possible for you to define an SSL certificate (sslTrustStoreLocation) and a password (sslTrustStorePassword) to unlock the keystore file. <br>• Added support for external business data sources. <br>• JCL - Added support for checkpoint mechanism for batch restart. <br>• JCL - Added support for DCB parameters record size and RDW. <br>• JCL - Added dynamic folder-name configuration for generated temporary files. <br>• REDIS - Added pool configuration in Redis configuration for JICS. <br>• REDIS - Added database index in Redis configuration for Catalog and JICS. <br>• BatchScript - Added propagation of step name for running program executions. <br>• CICS - Added support for the ADDRESS SET command. <br>• CICS - Added support for PURGE MESSAGE and JUSTIFY. **Improvements** <br>• JCL - INFUTILB - Enhanced support for disabling the null indicator based on YML property. <br>• JCL - INFUTILB - Improved support for the CHAR/BPCHAR datatype. <br>• JCL - ICEGENER - Added support for copying multiline input streams into files. <br>• JCL - IEBGENER - Improved support for handling conversion from Variable Block to Fixed Block files. <br>• JCL - DFSORT - Improved support for multi-digit parameters on operation DATE. <br>• JCL - DFSORT - Added support for the INCLUDE=ALL clause. <br>• JCL - Improved support for the SORT utility to handle the BDW field in output. <br>• JCL - Improved support for DD concatenation. <br>• JCL - Improved support for Input Stream. <br>• JCL - DSNUTILB - Improved support for the NULLIF() statement. <br>• JCL - INFUTILB - Added support for unloading data with the NOPAD option. <br>• JCL - INFUTILB - Enhanced support for current date in INFUTILB. <br>• JCL - Added file existence and size checks before using a file. <br>• JCL - GDG - Improved the handling of sub-directories for GDG. <br>• MQ - Improved connection opening in the JMS implementation. <br>• MQ - Improved data length setting of GET message for XA datasoure. <br>• MQ - Decomposed CMQV standard copybook to prevent compilation errors and refactoring uses. <br>• <noloc>Blusam</noloc> - Improved support for delete requests for non-existent data sets. <br>• Improved support for the ALLOCATE statement. <br>• Improved robustness of TS-QUEUE Naming. <br>• BatchScript - Enhanced preservation of previous step return code in job re-execution. <br>• Dataset - Improved the file existence check when a file exists and is temporary. <br>• Dataset - Improved the concurrency when locating GDG files to delete. <br>• Dataset - Added support for getting GDG Dataset record size. <br>• CICS - Improved support for the SUSPENDED option in the INQUIRE TASK LIST command. <br>• CICS - Improved support for LOAD SET using the ADDRESS OF statement. <br>• CICS - Improved unhandled CICS arguments REMOTESYSTEM when CICS INQUIRE. <br>• CICS - Enhanced support for the GETMAIN command to handle the SET option with a pointer defined with the OF keyword. <br>• JICS - Improved robustness for the jicsXAPrepare() method by adding the transaction state check. <br>• JICS XA - Added a check for transaction state and enhanced transaction thread termination. <br>• BAC - Enhanced role-based authentication on client side and refactored/centralized all API calls. <br>• BAC - Implemented a feature to block public access to BAC and JAC based on configuration <br>• BAC - Upgrade of the dependencies: Angular 17. <br>• BAC - Improved security integration with OAuth2. <br>• BAC - Enhanced hibernate generated DDL. <br>• BAC - Improved export data set mechanism. <br>• JAC - Updated to Angular 17 and reporting all specifics work from BAC (ROLE, sadmin conf, XSRF, logout). <br>• COBOL - Added support for the CHAR and ORD-MIN functions. <br>• Enhanced FileFactory to keep catalog record size in MOD disposition. <br>• Enabled logging using MDC for JICS transactions. <br>• Improved SQLCA > SQLSTATE produced for stored procedures generating ad-hoc result sets. <br>• Improved support for task scheduling related to last Spring upgrade. ### AS400 **New features** <br>• Added multi-node support for database record locks using Redis. <br>• Added support for BINARY CHARACTER for the DDS type. <br>• CL - Added support for custom report file generation. <br>• RPG - Added support for the RENAME keyword on primary/secondary files. **Improvements** <br>• Improved database support for handling the CTID column with a JOIN clause. <br>• Improved cursor position for multiple DSPATR(PC). <br>• Improved logging on read exception. <br>• Improved Quartz job logging to include job properties to MDC. <br>• Improved support for the AS400 help screen. <br>• CL - Improved support for the RMVJOBSCDE command to accept entry numbers with trailing spaces. <br>• CL - Improved support for the RMVJOBSCDE command to remove a job schedule using a generic job name. <br>• CL - Improved support for the SAVOBJ command to order records by table key. <br>• CL - Improved support for the CPYF command to establish a new connection for DB queries. <br>• CL - Improved insertion of inquiry messages in queue message with SNDPGMMSG. <br>• CL - Improved job queue configuration to specify default job queue. <br>• CL - Improved the CRTPF command to support the QTEMP library and the RCDLEN parameter. <br>• CL - Improved support for the CHKOBJ command - Check for partition with library. <br>• CL - Improved RTVMGS to send CPF2407 and CPF2419 when file/ID not found. <br>• CL - Improved CPYTOIMPF and CPYFRMIMPF interpretation of legacy formatting parameters. <br>• CL - Added support for OVRPRTF parameter USRDTA. <br>• CL - Improved the CPYTOIMPF CL command to establish a new connection to avoid closing existing result sets. <br>• CL - Improved CHGDTAARA so that it no longer modifies the data area length when it updates the content. <br>• CL - Improved ClCommand database connection handling. <br>• Optimized interaction between the front end and the back end. <br>• COBOL - Updated transformation to handle FILLER in copybooks. <br>• Improved additional message information display for custom messages sent to the front end. <br>• Updated the default value for the selector in app.component.ts. <br>• Improved text splitting in split-dynamic-field display. <br>• Improved the display of error message with multiple writes followed by a read. ### Transversal capabilities **New features** Added support for the dynamic configuration of OAuth2 provider secret. **Improvements** <br>• Printing - Improved QCMDEXC parameter support for handling quotation marks and improved report name formation <br>• Improved support for delimited syntax on RecordAdaptable. <br>• Enhanced InspectBuilder error logging to add context about source string. <br>• DataSimplifier - added robustness for ByteArray affectation. <br>• Enhanced MDC logging with new runtime attributes. ## Modernization tools release 4.1.0 ### zOS **New features** <br>• Added support for multiple CSD file transformations <br>• COBOL - Added support for the CICS ALLOCATE statement. <br>• COBOL - Added support for ON SIZE ERROR in the ADD CORRESPONDING statement. <br>• COBOL - Added support for EXIT PARAGRAPH. **Improvements** <br>• COBOL - Improved support for -INC copybook. <br>• COBOL - Enhanced support for FILLER initialization. <br>• COBOL - Improved support for figurative values comparison. <br>• COBOL - Enhanced support for WHEN ANY in consecutive WHEN clauses lacking intermediary code blocks. <br>• COBOL - Improved support for figurative constant. <br>• COBOL - Improved support for packed type size computation. <br>• COBOL - Improved unhandled CICS argument KEEP for SPOOLCLOSE. <br>• COBOL - Improved generation for the TEST-NUMVAL function. <br>• COBOL - Improved Java generation arguments on INSPECT framework support. <br>• CICS - Improved support for defining DFHCOMMAREA. ### AS400 **New features** <br>• RPG - Added an error-catching mechanism to generate the (incomplete) DDS so it won’t block program generation. <br>• Added support for the INCLUDE file description specification keyword. **Improvements** <br>• RPG - Improved full-free parsing. <br>• RPG - Added robustness with error catching. <br>• RPG - Improved initialization of field/DS with export keyword. <br>• RPG - Improved DAO operation to handle indicators. <br>• RPG - Handled the default value of PERRCD with CTDATA. <br>• RPG - Upgraded the Free-RPG parser to log a unique error per parsing rule. <br>• PRTF - Handled name collision between PRTF and JRXML. <br>• COBOL - Improved support of the LIKE keyword. ### Transversal capabilities **Improvements** <br>• Added robustness for ErrorID API <br>• Performance optimization for large project transformation. For example: timeout to skip blocked files, re-use of the classification from Blu Insights, and better memory allocations. <br>• Optimized the memory footprint during COBOL/PL1 transformation. <br>• Fixed CVE on third-party (jQuery and bootstrap). <br>• Managed timeoutParser options in TC. <br>• Improved the multiple spaces rewriting on SQL queries. <br>• Improved Read Only Cursor with sensitivity attribute. ## Release notes 4.0.0 Release date: April 8, 2024 For instructions on how to migrate from AWS Blu Age Runtime 3.10.0 to 4.0.0, see [Migrating from 3.10.0 to 4.0.0](ba-migration-notes.md#3.10-to-4.0 "ba-migration-notes.md#3.10-to-4.0"). This release of AWS Blu Age Runtime and Modernization Tools is focused on upgrading critical dependencies and supported technologies while boosting performance in multiple functionalities. Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• + **Upgrade from Spring Boot 2.7 to 3.2.4, Spring Core 5.3 to 6.1.5, and Tomcat 9.0 to 10.1.17** to provide improved security, performance, and maintainability by using versions that are actively being patched and maintained. + **Lazy loading on front-end application** to build faster large projects with more than 2000 screens and reduce the displaying initialization from 10 s to 300 ms. + **Support for DBCS display on front-end application**for enhancement of the support of double-byte characters to provide a new font that handles double-byte and single-byte characters, prevent single-byte input in a double-byte field, and handle fields with mixed double-byte and single-byte characters. + **Thread monitoring feature for AS400 Online application** to run AS400 application with parallelization. + **Improved performance on context and RunUnit initialization** by adding a configurable mechanism to pre-initialize program context reducing the impact of loading complex structures inherent in legacy complexity. This version of the AWS Blu Age Runtime was tested with the following stack. Other versions might also be compatible. Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• Version upgrade from Java 8 to Java 17, increasing security and performance, and allowing customers to deploy and run applications implemented in a more modern language and to use recent third-party framework versions. <br>• Additional support for managing large shared memory spaces between users or jobs, storing data reusable after application or instance restart. <br>• Faster access to large data sets in <noloc>Blusam</noloc> using a pagination mechanism that makes it possible to retrieve a subset of records incrementally. For more information about the changes included in this release, see the following sections. ## Runtime release 3.10.0 This runtime is based on Java17, Spring2.7, and Angular16. ### zOS **New features** <br>• <noloc>Blusam</noloc> - Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• Version upgrade from Angular 13 to Angular 16, increasing security and giving access to new features that improve the performance in customer’s online applications. <br>• Add support of cross job features in AS400, with the main high-light that jobs can send inquiry messages synchronously among them, enabling decoupling in modernized jobs. <br>• Performance improvements on the usage of Redis, including connection pool optimization, high security on connection and upgraded dataset locking mechanism. on multiple transversal enhancements across the product to improve its quality and security, along with improvements in performance for caching and the unification of commands supports in a single distribution. Some key features and changes in this release are: <br>• Version upgrade from Spring 2.5 to Spring 2.7, increasing the maintenance support, performance, and security of the platform. <br>• Unification of more than 82 CL commands support as part of the over-the-counter distribution in order to facilitate the usage and deployment of modernized applications previously using CL scripting. <br>• New APIs available to operate and interact better with <noloc>Blusam</noloc> datasets, such as integrated import to the managed service and the capability to list dataset metadata information. <br>• Performance improvements and extension of the usage of Redis, including availability in cluster mode, high availability data retrieval, standardization of the usage of secrets. notes 3.7.0 This release of AWS Blu Age Runtime and Modernization Tools mainly includes enhancements to better support commands and utilities, capabilities to integrate with AWS Secrets Manager and new monitoring features. Some of the key changes in this release are: <br>• Multiple runtime components can now use AWS Secrets Manager to increase the security setup of modernized applications, mostly related to utilities data sources, Redis for TS Queues, <noloc>Blusam</noloc> cache and locks. <br>• Monitoring endpoint that allows to retrieve transaction, batch, and JVM metrics for resource usage optimization and operational management, such as status, duration, volume, and others. <br>• New features to support IBM MQ calls in RPG, and increased JCL SORT and IDCAMS transformation coverage. Some of the key changes in this release are: <br>• Enhancement of JCL dynamic file handling, expansion of current statements and management of concatenated datasets, execution of multiple statements in a single block, and data transfer from batches to programs. <br>• Enhanced support of multiple CICS commands, including inquiry for several CICS resource types. <br>• The capability to have different databases when using Blu Age Runtime Utilities, best suited for scenarios when business data is distributed across multiple sources. (V7-9674) <br>• Improvement on MOVEA (V7-9773) ## Release notes 3.5.0 This release of AWS Blu Age Runtime and Modernization Tools provides new features for both zOS and AS400 legacy migrations, mainly oriented to datasets and messaging optimization, as well as extended Java capabilities as a resulting asset of the transformation process. Some of the key changes in this release are: <br>• Capability of migrating CL programs to Java in addition to the pre-existent groovy scripts feature, to facilitate its integration with other modernized programs, and to simplify customer learning curve by unifying the resulting programming language. <br>• Time reduction and optimization of the performance of dataset loads in Redis with the new data bulk feature. <br>• Ability to operate and pass datasets within job steps to modernize traditional datasets behaviors. <br>• Extension of SQL migration to support VB input files and Java 11 simplified migration. <br>• Multiple new mechanisms for faster integration with IBM MQ including additional headers, extended GET/PUT support and automatic retrieve of queue metadata. <br>• REST Endpoint for datasets metadata and import datasets from S3 buckets. For more information about the changes included in this release, see the following sections. ## Runtime release 3.5.0 ###### Topics <br>• [zOS](#runtime-zos "#runtime-zos") <br>• [AS400](#runtime-as400 "#runtime-as400") <br>• [Transversal capabilities](#runtime-transversal "#runtime-transversal") ### zOS **New features** <br>• JCL SORT - Handle new keyword overlay (V7-9409) <br>• ZOS COBOL - enhance support of floating char (V7-9404) <br>• Port of RedisJicsTSQueue to RedisTemplate & ListOperations (V7-9212) <br>• ZOS JCL - enhance temporary directory's path with files directory if defined through UserDefinedParameters (V7-9012) <br>• Handle FUNCTION ORD-MAX with ALL (all array items) (V7-9366) <br>• Prefixed and human-readable keys are now used when storing TS Queues in Redis (V7-9212) <br>• Add get dataset endpoint for <noloc>Blusam</noloc> API <br>• JCL - ADD support for batch job with name involving special character like # (V7-9136) <br>• TSModel fetching is now robustly performed on demand (V7-9212) **Improvements** <br>• Non-versioned INCLUDE support in LNK files (V7-6022) <br>• MQ - Enhance encoding support (V7-9652) <br>• Improving support for double bytes or mixed charsets for varying character type (V7-9596) <br>• JCL - Support of filesDirectory configuration in IDCAMS delete NONVSAM statements (V7-9609) <br>• Support bulk mode for ESDS and RRDS datasets loading from files (V7-8639) <br>• Handle the opening of empty ESDS in input mode. (V7-9287) <br>• Enhance DEFINE CLUSTER statement with ORD/UNORD abbreviation support (V7-9451) <br>• <noloc>Blusam</noloc> Redis lock performance improvements (V7-8639) <br>• Enhance DEFINE CLUSTER statement to support RECORDSIZE provided in DATA() argument scope (V7-9337) <br>• Adds support of BUFFERSPACE/UNIQUE attributes on DEFINE CLUSTER statements (V7-9419) <br>• Improve <noloc>Blusam</noloc> read operation for variable length record dataset.
